subject.title: [Feature]: Webhook hook sessions should reuse existing session when sessionKey is consistent (multi-turn support)

question: Should trusted hook-agent callers get persistent session reuse only through an explicit sessionMode opt-in, or should OpenClaw keep hook-agent runs isolated and update docs instead?
rationale: The remaining change affects external hook ingress and session identity, so automation should not choose between compatibility, security, and product semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Explicit persistent opt-in
options.body: Add sessionMode: "isolated" | "persistent" across direct hooks, mappings, and transforms, keep isolated as default, and require existing hook token/sessionKey prefix gates for persistent reuse.

options.title: Docs-only isolation
options.body: Keep hook-agent sessions always isolated and update user-facing docs to remove the multi-turn sessionKey expectation for hooks.

options.title: Automatic stable-key reuse
options.body: Reuse existing sessions automatically for stable hook sessionKey values, accepting broader compatibility and security-boundary risk.

recommendation.title: Explicit persistent opt-in
recommendation.body: Add sessionMode: "isolated" | "persistent" across direct hooks, mappings, and transforms, keep isolated as default, and require existing hook token/sessionKey prefix gates for persistent reuse.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the latest maintainer cleanup direction and current-line history for the central hook/session code paths.
